definitions.gloss: adult insect; imago; fully grown insect
definitions.explanation: An insect that has completed all stages of metamorphosis and reached its final, mature form. Contrasts with larva and pupa stages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成虫|せいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The larva becomes an adult insect.

examples.japanese: ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成虫|せいちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Adult rhinoceros beetles can only be seen in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦セミ→セミ：09931_semi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{成虫|せいちゅう}になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
examples.english: Cicadas have a very short lifespan after becoming adults.

notes:
{成虫|せいちゅう} is the final stage in an insect's life cycle — the fully developed adult form capable of reproduction.

LIFE CYCLE STAGES:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: egg
- ⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧: larva
- ⟦{蛹|さなぎ}→蛹：21225_sanagi⟧: pupa, chrysalis
- {成虫|せいちゅう}: adult insect (imago)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成虫|せいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an adult (insect)
- {成虫|せいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧: adult insect's lifespan
- {成虫|せいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to emerge as an adult (from pupa)

FORMS:
{成|せい} (mature, complete) + {虫|ちゅう} (insect).

Used in science education (⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧) and nature observation. Japanese children often learn this vocabulary through ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧ (rhinoceros beetle) and ⟦セミ→セミ：09931_semi⟧ (cicada) life cycles.
